label: input token w during the original phase
explanation: Single-token detector: fires whenever the input is the letter w during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase, active on ~54% of such steps at any position and any L, with zero false positives on dev (precision 1.0, recall 0.997). It does not fire on any other input token (only rare tiny activations ~0.15 on t/m), never on the delimiter, and essentially never in the copy phase, even when w is fed back as an output (only ~0.15 there). Magnitude in the examples: largest (~0.98-1.0 of max) when w is the last original token right before <DEL>, ~0.87 at position 0, ~0.7-0.85 in the middle; a repeated w (not its first occurrence) is weaker (~0.6-0.7).

issues: The core predicate holds on test: precision 1.0, recall 0.997, F1 0.998, mass recall 0.999, with 0 false positives. The 343 missed steps (0.1% of activation mass) are scattered weak activations of about 0.15 on t and m at the last original position. They are noise, not a systematic class.

The secondary claims check out. The feature never fires on <DEL> (0 of 500k). It essentially never fires in the copy phase: 86 of 2.7M steps, and with phase==2 & in_tok==w the precision is 0.001 and mass 0.0002. Repeated w is part of the feature: (in_first==0) gives precision 1.0 and covers 9.3% of activations, so requiring the first occurrence drops recall to 0.904.

The magnitude claim is wrong. The explanation says activations peak (0.98 to 1.0 of max) when w is the last original token. But to_go==0 & w gives recall 0.158 and mass recall 0.154, so the mean activation there is slightly BELOW average (about 0.97x). From the profile, the mean per bucket (mass share / active share) is about 1.09x at t=0 and 1.11x at to_go=8, versus about 0.89x at t=3. Early positions, especially position 0, are the strongest, not the last one. Those few top examples were cherry-picked, not the trend.
The claim that repeated w is much weaker (0.6 to 0.7) is overstated. Repeated-w steps carry mass/recall of 0.088/0.093, about 0.95x the mean, so they are only slightly weaker.
skeptic.revised_label: input token w during the original phase (any position, including repeats); magnitude slightly higher at early positions

final_label: input token w during the original phase (any position, including repeats); magnitude slightly higher at early positions
